category.name: Stone, Marble & Concrete
category.description: Marbles, granites, terrazzo, quartz, concrete, plaster, stucco, slate and natural stone slabs.

materials.name: Sidewalk Expansion Joint
materials.description: Broom-finished concrete sidewalk slabs with chamfered control joints. Architectural concrete with trowel marks, pores and form-work imprints.

projection.tiling_note: Triplanar suits monolithic pours; board-formed variants need UVs with boards horizontal.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 3 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 3 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Concrete stains under drips, darkens when wet and grows algae at the base.

materials.name: Terrazzo Speckled Stone
materials.description: Honed terrazzo cement with multi-colored angular marble aggregate. Crystalline speckled aggregate slabs, engineered quartz and terrazzo.

projection.tiling_note: Speckled aggregates hide seams well; triplanar works on chunky countertop edges.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Hard aggregates resist wear; only faint scuffs and dust.

materials.name: Venetian Plaster Trowel
materials.description: Hand-troweled architectural lime plaster with sweeping trowel ridges. Hand-applied lime plaster, stucco and drywall finishes with soft trowel relief.

projection.tiling_note: Triplanar or world-space UVs keep trowel swirls continuous across corners.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 2 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 2 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Interior plaster takes scuffs at hand height; exterior stucco takes rain streaks.

materials.name: Carrara Veined Marble
materials.description: Polished white Italian Carrara marble with feathery blue-gray veins. Polished natural stone with physically scaled veining and soft cloud variation.

projection.tiling_note: Use one continuous UV island per slab so veins flow across edges; bookmatch by mirroring UVs.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1.2 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1.2 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Polished stone stays clean; add faint etch wear around sinks and thresholds.
